news.body: Since the site hasn't been touched in what seems like forever, the band has taken the liberty to post many new things. This includes new songs in both WMA and MP3 format in the Audio section. Sorry, we will only be offering 128kbps as of now. There are also other updates throughout the web site. Feel free to check them out. Band Member Update
news.title: Updated Songs and Site

news.body: For those of you who have been loyal supporters of the band, please take note that LiS has made a decision. They are now looking for a bass player and possibly a lead vocalist (again). If you believe you can fill the position, please email the band . Scheduled Date
news.title: Band Member Update

news.body: With many events occuring during this holiday break, the release date of the new songs may be pushed back. LiS is not sure of when things will come around but are constantly trying to get things together. Scheduled Big Release!
news.title: Scheduled Date

news.body: After much planning and discussion, LiS has decided to schedule the due date for all of their new songs. The new due date is December 31, 2004. Look forward to this date as we will be releasing final versions of all of our songs. New Song!
news.title: Scheduled Big Release!

news.body: There's a new song in the audio section! Check it out, it's called Stoned . Jam/Recording Session
news.title: New Song!

news.body: A Jam/Recording session is scheduled for tomorrow (the 29th). However, we have not been able to practice in the past month due to schedule conflicts, so we hope this to work out. Jam/Recording Session
news.title: Jam/Recording Session

news.body: A Jam/Recording session is schedule for next Wednesday (the 13th). We are hoping to do multiple things, including record new songs we've been working as well as test out our new guitar player. Also, she may become the lead singer. Site Revamp (Again)
news.title: Jam/Recording Session

news.body: The site has been redone yet again. It is entering it's final phases and should be complete soon. Status Check
news.title: Site Revamp (Again)

news.body: Currently, LIS has been working on 4 new songs. They also have been working to fix up their original songs using the input everyone has had. Look forward to listening to the new songs on the site, so keep checking back for updates. Site Revamp
news.title: Status Check

news.body: Our web site has currently been under a lot of construction since our big name change. As of currently, we are still in a beta form of the site, so look forward to a more interactive and visually appealing site. Name Changed
news.title: Site Revamp

news.body: Due to some naming conflicts we have become aware of, our name has changed to Lost in Sanity . The name of our band used to be THEM . Please note, we also changed the name of our EP, from the THEM EP to The Lost Insanity EP . Production Notes
news.title: Name Changed

news.body: The production status of The Lost Insanity EP is on schedule and will be ready for distribution on the 7th of September. The CD is currently in the final production state. CD Release Date Changed
news.title: Production Notes

news.body: Due to the progress rate of the current album, the final release date has been pushed to Tuesday, September 7, 2004. New Song
news.title: CD Release Date Changed

news.body: A new song is available in the Discography section of the web site, Things We've Done . Jam Session Scheduled
news.title: New Song

news.body: Another jam/recording session is scheduled for this Friday (August 20)! A new song is in the process of being written and will be recorded and made into almost final form. Also, another two songs from the last session which were not completed will hopefully be finished. This will boost our new album up to eight (8!!) songs total. We may stop there for now and try to get the other songs in the final and best form instead of trying to write more. New Songs
news.title: Jam Session Scheduled

news.body: Lost In Sanity has recorded new songs and re-recorded their older ones to give a better final versions. The two new songs are Disgrace and Back to School . In addition to the new songs, every song is now offered in a lower quality format to allow for preview/quick downloading to the people still using a dial-up internet connection. We're trying our hardest to get our songs to as many people as possible. Jam/Recording Session Scheduled
news.title: New Songs

news.body: A Lost In Sanity jam/recording session is schedule for this coming Friday (August 13)! 4 new songs are in the working and should be released later that day or the following. Also, look forward to a completed version of Hold My Ground , as well as the other songs being recorded to their final and completed form. So Sad Release
news.title: Jam/Recording Session Scheduled

news.body: A new song, So Sad , is available for download. Also, Hold My Ground is almost in a finished state. Be looking forward to more songs coming soon! Jam/Recording Session Scheduled
news.title: So Sad Release

news.body: A Lost In Sanity jam/recording session is scheduled for August 06, 2004. Be looking for a few new (finished) songs on the web site on the 7th. Sessions Date Set
news.title: Jam/Recording Session Scheduled

news.body: The progressing album The Lost Insanity EP is due out by August 31st. Keep your eyes open for this album, as it will be Lost In Sanity's debut. Hangover Blues Available
news.title: Sessions Date Set

news.body: Hangover Blues is available for download. The song has been completed and is ready for the world to hear. It is available in the Discography section of this site. If you download it, please send your comments to our band .
news.title: Hangover Blues Available

journal.body: 2:59 P.M.] Hey everyone! Sorry it has been so long. Obviously we were not able to accomplish finishing our songs by December 31st. We did try to and we came out with some nicer versions of the songs. Of course, as always, they are available in the Audio section (now with MP3 format available). We have been working on a few things, including writing better music. We were going to do Battle of the Bands, but unfortunately, Josh has a hockey game the same day as it. We'll keep you all updated on what happens.
journal.title: Brandon's Journal

journal.body: 4:24 P.M.] Yeah, it has been a very long time since the last update. We have managed to get one song on the web site. Sorry about the quality, it was kind of on the spot and all. I didn't think it was that bad. Don't worry though, we'll get the final copies of all of our songs out soon. We are planning to finish the new stuff by December 31, 2004. School has been a pain for recording, we have exams all this week. Not cool at all. Oh well, I'll be back later to keep you all posted.

It still has some changed to come, but it is getting to its final state. We had a jam session this past Saturday. It went okay, but we didn't get much done. journal.body: 4:18 P.M.] I've been working on a new site design lately. Still trying to a find a nice one that fits the band. As of right now, it's based off the original THEM web site. It has a nice look, but it could be better. Check back every so often to see the progress. Also, I finished writing a song on guitar, it'll be a catchy song for you all to listen to. Josh is working on the lyrics to it. If I were to compare it to a song, it would be Hitchin' A Ride by Green Day . Which, oddly enough, their song was a Stray Cats style.

journal.body: 3:07 P.M.] It has been a very long time since I have posted, so I thought I would give you all the updates. As you can probably tell from the web site, we have changed our name. This is from a naming conflict that has arisen which we quickly took care of. This was a good thing to avoid as we do not care to get sued. Also, after distributing the THEM EP (now named The Lost Insanity EP), we have recieved many of your comments. Thank you all for inputing your thoughts, it has helped us a lot. The next CD we put out will be generated from many of the comments recieved as well as many of our own improvements. The songs will all be revised to give an over all better quality as well as better songs overall. Much research has been getting put into our music thanks to all of our loyal fans. Thank you everyone! On a sadder note, school has started. Due to this little blockade, jamming will be cut down. We are still working our butts off to complete everything and become something that you all can't take out of your CD players, but it takes time.
journal.title: style.

journal.body: 2:57 P.M.] Well, it has been a few days since I have written on here and I figured now would be a good time. A few days ago (Wednesday, September 1st), Josh and I had the final recording session for the EP. It took us over 10 hours total to get just the recording done. We did get to finish it though. As of now, I am working on the final production of our CD. The CD's are being created, the labels and packaging are being done, and everything is being readied for the 7th. I can only hope it all gets done soon, as we are going to start working on the completed Lost In Sanity album this Sunday (the 5th).

journal.body: 7:02 P.M.] Okay everyone, after many changes and all we have finally decided on the date of releasing the EP. September 7th, 2004 will be the official released date of The Lost Insanity EP . This Wednesday (Sept. 1st) or Thursday (Sept. 2) we are going to have our final jam/recording session for the EP. This also means we are going to work on getting the cover and labels printed and the CDs produced. So look forward to the CD coming soon!

journal.body: 9:55 P.M.] Josh stopped by after work today and we worked a few finishing touches out on the songs. He has been writing the lyrics out into their final forms, as well as developing a couple new songs. It almost seems strange the rate we're are coming up with things. It looks like The Lost Insanity EP will have a B-Side to it. The final CD may have all the songs on it, but I'm not too sure about that. Anyway, I've been thinking a lot about sending in demo CDs to some record labels. See if Lost In Sanity can get noticed by anyone. We need to start getting some gigs. That's all I know.

journal.body: 2:16 P.M.] Tomorrow we are having another jam/recording session. I wrote a new song on guitar that we are going to turn into a finished product. It will probably be the most complex song (I chose to write one a little more complex because people were saying that there was too much repetition in the others, I personally think it is almost what makes them catchy). So, Josh and will be starting early (for us, which is 1 or 2 in the afternoon) and getting some things done. Not that I endorse any products on this site besides our own, but we may go watch Alien Vs. Predator (which is going to be awesome, my dad saw it and said it kicked!). Not that it has to do with anything, but I thought I would tell you all. Well, time for me to go, I'm heading to Muskegon to do some clothes shopping and to go out for lunch; talk to you all tomorrow.

journal.body: 9:36 P.M.] The Jam Session today kicked ass! We whipped through it crazy fast and had and awesome turn out with the songs. I love how today went. I think we will get this CD done very quickly, which is actually kind of scary to me. I mean, if you think about it all, it almost seems like we are doing this all way too fast. It makes me think we should delay the CD or just release it as a " Demo " kind of thing.

journal.body: 5:02 A.M.] Well, I can't sleep so I thought I would write an entry. The band is doing well so far. Josh and I have been working on a few new songs, about four or so, and we will be recording them on Friday. Hopefully we get them finished. Also, we might re-record the other three songs to give a better final product. I hope our CD is done by the end of the month. That would be awesome. It would give us something to distribute at school. For those of you who haven't noticed, I redesigned the logo a bit. And for those of you who don't know, I'm the one who created the web site. Nothing too fancy, just something simple to let everyone know what's going on. Today I posted all the updates for the site. I also added this section. You all should enjoy the writings to come.
